Evidence_Note: DPP4 is a well-established therapeutic target in type 2 diabetes.
FFAR1 has been investigated as a therapeutic target for type 2 diabetes and insulin secretion.
PPAR-gamma is an established pharmacological target related to insulin sensitivity and type 2 diabetes.
FTO has genetic and disease-association evidence related to type 2 diabetes, but it should not be treated as an established therapeutic target in this analysis.
SLC22A1 is included as a diabetes-relevant transporter candidate for exploratory screening, not as a confirmed therapeutic target.
SLC22A2 is included as a diabetes-relevant transporter candidate for exploratory screening, not as a confirmed therapeutic target.
